{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZbHq3Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhDCeTg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 81, "title": "Add an evidence-qualified NetNews reading and header-search journey from MAIN 7", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `0b982e2289255b53fcaae56aa93a0a4200c0910e`, selecting MAIN `7 インターネット` displays `記事一覧：0件`. `LIST` repeats the empty collection and reading/searching is unavailable. Users cannot experience the documented NetNews service.

This advances the intentionally limited [placeholder scope #33](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/33), rather than fixing a regression. Keep it distinct from the completed [MAIN 3 wire-news journey #77](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/77).

## Expected outcome

Provide this browser-local keyboard journey:

`MAIN or index → 7 Internet → NetNews → group directory → article list → Subject/From search → complete article → contextual return`

Implement two period-attested example groups, `fj.questions.fj` and `fj.news.usage`, with three short original Japanese articles per group. Include a question and followup, distinct fictional authors, and enough overlapping headers to demonstrate multiple search results. These are illustrative content and selected-group carriage reconstructions, not recovered PC-VAN articles or an authenticated service directory.

Use discoverable reconstructed controls: numeric directory selections, `READ number`, `SEARCH SUBJECT text`, `SEARCH FROM text`, `LIST`, `BACK`, `MAIN` and `HELP`. These commands are product conventions, not historically authenticated syntax.

## Context

### Historical evidence and reconstruction judgment

Sources inspected live on 2026-10-24:

- [Internet Magazine, April 1995, printed page 105](https://iwparchives.jp/wp-content/themes/twentytwelve/bn/pdf/im199504-104-bbs.pdf) specifically describes PC-VAN carrying several NetNews hierarchies, including fj, and searching article headers by subject or author. Confidence is high for that earlier snapshot; continuation into November 1996 is a reasonable, disclosed assumption. Its read-only restriction and two-week retention must not automatically become target-year behavior. Neighboring providers' menus and commands are separate evidence.
- [Internet White Paper 1996, comparison labeled January 1996](https://iwparchives.jp/files/pdf/iwp1996/iwp1996-ch04-01-p110.pdf) reports PC-VAN NetNews reading and posting. Confidence is moderate to high in this contemporary comparative report, but it supplies neither activation dates nor host commands. A reading-only implementation subset must not claim that historical 1996 posting was unavailable. PDF text/table extraction was inspected; no usable page-image comparison was assessed.
- [fj.* participant guide, April 1996](https://www2.biglobe.ne.jp/~nir/misc/fj-no-arukikata/) distinguishes reading, posting and followups. Its [group chapter](https://www2.biglobe.ne.jp/~nir/misc/fj-no-arukikata/3.4.html) explains hierarchical group organization and explicitly says individual sites choose which groups to carry. This is strong period evidence for the general service model, not proof of PC-VAN's individual subscriptions. The guide uses instructional fictional dialogue rather than captured sessions.
- A [preserved glossary article dated November 2, 1996](https://ie.u-ryukyu.ac.jp/~kono/fj/fj.beginners/318.html) attests the selected group names and distinguishes Newsgroups, From, Subject, Date, Message-ID and References. Confidence is high in the displayed period structure; it does not establish PC-VAN carriage or header rendering. Do not reuse its identities or prose. The guide's linked Subject chapter remained inaccessible; this readable alternative supplies header evidence.
- The [retrospective MAIN reproduction labeled circa 1996](https://www.paradisearmy.com/doujin/pasok3pc-van.htm) places Internet at MAIN 7. Confidence is high in the reproduction's contents; historical authenticity and revision chronology remain provisional.

Judgment: group-based browsing and separate Subject/From searching are sufficiently supported for this bounded increment. Exact host menus, selectors, search matching, errors, return behavior and individual group carriage remain reconstruction. Document those assumptions through existing research and Settings/About surfaces, keeping normal terminal output concise.

### Implementation and existing evidence

- `src/sections.ts` maps selector 7 to generic articles. `src/navigation.ts` owns section entry, screen state, rendering and return paths. Its ordinary command normalization uppercases and collapses whitespace; parse search queries from the original submitted line so authored text is preserved.
- `src/news.ts` and its navigation handlers provide a small bundled list/detail pattern. Reuse suitable conventions without introducing a general service framework.
- Keep new screens outside `forum`, `mailContext`, `isConference`, `isOlt` and community-content loading contexts. `src/main.ts` and `src/commands.ts` use these contexts for reading and composition side effects.
- `tests/sections.spec.ts` currently includes MAIN 7 among empty collections and expects its generic screen. Update obsolete assertions while retaining other destinations' coverage. `tests/news.spec.ts` and `tests/terminal-helpers.ts` provide existing controller, production-browser, backup-comparison and literal-rendering patterns.
- Update the README destination/command guidance, `docs/research/pcvan-1996-1997.md` and existing Settings/About content.

Live repository searches returned no open Issues or PRs. NetNews/Internet history searches recovered related placeholder, news and resident-setting scopes without an equivalent pending journey; lexical searches are not exhaustive.

[PR #80](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/80) and `docs/validation.md` record 276 passing checks, configured TypeScript checking/build and publication diff review for the preceding OLT change. These are Coordinator records, not validation of this proposal. This research graph ran no application or validation suites.

Scope excludes posting, external connections, credentials, WWW/TELNET/FTP, subscription/unread persistence, expiry simulation, crossposting, thread-navigation systems, schema migrations and other MAIN destinations.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] MAIN 7 opens a concise Internet directory with a working NetNews selection. Its group directory exposes the two specified groups; each opens three original articles. Anonymous reading/searching works without AI consent, a model, credentials or external access. Identify this as the implemented subset through on-demand provenance, without suggesting that omitted historical capabilities were unavailable.
- [ ] Lists show stable group-local article numbers, Subject and From. Full articles show Newsgroups, From, Subject, Date and Message-ID; at least one followup has References pointing to an included original article. Use fictional names and `.invalid` addresses/identifiers, with explicitly authored early-November-1996 dates. Do not copy archival prose, identities or screenshots, reuse local member keys as Internet authors, or dynamically redate these fixed examples.
- [ ] `SEARCH SUBJECT text` and `SEARCH FROM text` search only the selected header within the selected group's complete corpus. Define matching as literal substring after trimming query ends, case-insensitive for Latin text, without regex, Boolean operators or body matching. Preserve query spelling and internal whitespace in display. Searches replace the active results rather than progressively filtering prior results. Show the field, query and accurate zero/one/multiple result count. Filtering never renumbers articles; `READ` resolves only numbers in the active results.
- [ ] `HELP` redisplays the current view without changing selection/filter. `BACK` from an article restores its active list/filter, then follows group list → group directory → Internet directory → actual entry parent, including index entry. `LIST` clears a group filter and returns to that group's complete list. `MAIN` works at every depth and clears transient navigation/search state. Repeated searches, reads and visits add no duplicate parents or stale cross-group selections.
- [ ] Missing queries, unknown search fields, malformed/unsafe/out-of-range article numbers and unrelated service commands produce contextual responses without mutating the active view or protected records. Existing global shortcuts and Settings/About return behavior remain usable. NetNews commands cannot initiate forum/mail/conference composition or OLT participation.
- [ ] Keep the corpus bundled outside IndexedDB and exported backups. Browsing/searching must not seed or modify members, SIGs/forums/posts, mail, read markers, conference/OLT records, consent, scheduling or calendar settings. Restored empty community collections remain empty. Preserve ordinary session/history behavior and existing activity lifecycle semantics.
- [ ] Extend existing Playwright/controller coverage for every article, both search fields, Japanese and mixed-case queries, internal whitespace, zero/one/multiple matches, header-versus-body exclusion, group isolation, stable numbers, invalid input, direct/index returns and repeated navigation. Include production keyboard journeys for anonymous restored-empty and registered worlds, with automatic activity paused for protected-record/backup comparisons. Verify literal headers/body/log export, Settings return context, composing-Enter protection and usable input/scrolling at 320px; observe no external requests.
- [ ] Update provenance with source URLs, inspection dates, historical scope, confidence, inaccessible-source limits and the chosen reconstruction assumptions. Explicitly distinguish the 1995 restrictions from the 1996 capability table, and general fj existence from PC-VAN carriage. Preserve existing functional, storage/import/reset, consent, calendar, composition/IME and terminal pacing/skip regression coverage.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs documented `npm test` before merge; the existing Playwright configuration already performs TypeScript checking and the production build. Use existing tooling and fixtures, with no new framework or real-model execution. Review the complete diff, documentation links and whitespace, and record actual results and any failures accurately.

## Optional validation

Additional comparison with a subsequently recovered dated PC-VAN NetNews session or visual review of Japanese header readability. Neither human confirmation, physical terminal/native-IME testing nor an authenticated screenshot match is a completion gate.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. This scope can be verified against local production assets before merge.
